name: [🐟] Fish World
desc:
🥈UPDATED!
Dive into FISH WORLD, catch MYTHICAL creatures, explore the ocean, and have fun with your FRIENDS!

HOW TO PLAY:
1. THROW your fishing rod. 
2. HOLD the button and FIGHT the fish! 
3. PULL it out and CATCH it!

The better your rod, the better fish you can get!
Don’t forget to leave a like, join our community and send your feedback!

🍀You get double luck on weekends!
(Double luck multiplier starts on every saturday, 0:00 UTC+0 and ends on every sunday, 23:59 UTC+0)

✨ GOOD LUCK, FISHER!
